description: This file defines the class EventMigrationStatus which manages the tracking of migration process statistics related to calendar events, including counts of processed, migrated, skipped, errors, and detailed per-event status.

classes.name: EventMigrationStatus
classes.description: Class for tracking statistics of event migration, including counts of processed, migrated, skipped, errors, and detailed event info.

methods.name: incrementProcessed
methods.description: Increments the count of processed events.

methods.name: addDetail
methods.description: Adds a detailed event migration result and updates counters based on event type.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation summarizing migration statistics and details.
